summary: Tested password-reset emails, reset HTML page/confirm, Emergent Google session, Google redirect, WhatsApp share, payments 503, and regression of register/forgot/plans. Found one CRITICAL bug and fixed it: POST /api/auth/password-reset/request returned 500 (TypeError: naive vs aware datetime) on any repeat request for an email that already had a reset record, including delivered@resend.dev. After the fix, all 14 backend tests pass. The email API returned 202 Accepted for a first-time resend.dev address; admin@rotasegura.com returns 422 'undeliverable recipient', which is expected for test data. Frontend: admin login lands in tabs. The Google button is enabled and redirects to auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/ (Google sign-in page shown). On /share with geolocation granted, the share is created, share-whatsapp-button appears and opens https://wa.me/?text=<encoded message + link>. Plans subscribe shows the 'Pagamentos ainda não configurados' toast. No deprecated expo packages detected.

critical.issue: 500 TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes (server.py:277). Motor returns naive datetimes but now() is tz-aware, so any second request for a registered email crashed. FIXED by T1: normalize created_at to UTC before comparing.

minor.issue: The token is put into an inline JS string using HTML escape(). A backslash in the token would break the JS. Use json.dumps(token) for the JS context instead.
auth_providers stores sub=email instead of the Google user id. New Google users get lgpd_consent_at set without an explicit consent step (only a small notice on the login screen).

ui_bugs.issue: If location permission is not granted, only the PermissionCard renders, even when a share is already active. The user cannot see or stop the active share (share-stop-button is not reachable). Reproduced: active share + no geolocation permission = permission card only. Show share-active-card / stop even without permission (share.tsx:124-132).
One `loading` state is shared by the Entrar and Google buttons, so both show a spinner during either flow.

integration_issues.issue: If the /auth/session exchange fails, the error is caught silently and the user lands on login with no error message. Surface a message.

issues: Toast renders over the ScreenHeader title (overlaps the back button/title while visible).

action_items: Review the T1 fix in server.py request_password_reset (tz normalization), or create the Motor client with tz_aware=True globally. Check other datetime fields read from Mongo.
share.tsx: allow viewing/stopping an active share when location permission is denied.
auth.tsx: show an error when the web Google session exchange fails.
Reset page: use json.dumps for the token in the inline script.
server.py is ~1800 lines: split it into routers/modules.
critical_code_review_comments: Mixed datetime storage (ISO strings in most collections, BSON datetimes in password_resets) without tz_aware=True caused the 500.
Google login is not verifiable end-to-end by automation; only the redirect was verified.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ users delivered+test<hex>@resend.dev; deleted by id afterwards. Started and then stopped one share on the admin account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Use delivered+<label>@resend.dev for reset emails (2-min resend window per email). Checkout needs plan_id (premium_mensal/premium_anual) and returns 503 without STRIPE_API_KEY. /share needs geolocation permission granted in the Playwright context.
rca_of_issue: Repro: POST /api/auth/password-reset/request twice with the same registered email -> second call 500. Root cause: created_at is stored as a BSON datetime and read back naive; now() is aware; subtracting them raises TypeError. Mitigation: replace(tzinfo=utc) before the comparison (applied).
